activities.title: Quiet Ward Visit
activities.summary: Spend time with Lily. No cure, no grand speech, just showing up.

ops.title: Quiet Ward Visit
ops.text: Lily did most of the talking. Bin did most of the pretending he was fine. Both of them knew the rules.

activities.title: Crystal Stabilizer Test
activities.summary: Spend a Haven memory shard or similar crystal material on a careful support treatment.

ops.title: Crystal Support Tested
ops.summary: A cross-world material helped Lily stabilize, but did not solve the illness.

ops.title: Crystal Stabilizer Test
ops.text: The monitor line steadied for three seconds longer than it should have. Hope is rude like that.

activities.title: Med-Gel Analysis
activities.summary: Use scavenged medical gel from Last Light to unlock a safer hospital support path.

ops.title: Med-Gel Path Open
ops.summary: Zombie-world salvage can support Lily's treatment under careful rules.

activities.title: Delivery Shift
activities.summary: Earn Earth money, risk attention, and collect ordinary-life texture.

ops.title: Delivery Shift
ops.text: Three orders, one broken elevator, and a tip paid entirely in coins. The universe remains committed to bit work.

journalEntries.title: After Haven Arc 1
journalEntries.text: Haven proved the impossible can hurt, help, and follow him home. Earth did not pause while Bin was learning how to survive somewhere else.

journalEntries.title: Earth Return Notes
journalEntries.text: Earth is for school, bills, hospital visits, old scars, and the small daily scenes that make every other world matter.
